params.unwrapTarget: ERC4626 wrapper (== mp.collateralToken) to redeem before the swap when the wrapper itself has no DEX liquidity but its underlying does (wsuperOETHb -> superOETHb); the swap calldata must then spend the UNDERLYING. address(0) = no unwrap (unchanged path).

params.deadline: plan TTL as unix ts; must be in the future.
params.triggerPrice: fire filter in ORACLE-WRAPPER units (1e36-scaled collateral-in-loan, NOT the Chainlink feed the predictor watches): probe attempts only when price() <= trigger. 0 disables the filter (every authorized probe attempts) — fail-open by construction.

batchLiquidate(((address,address,address.notice: Liquidate up to N targets in ONE tx (cascade capture: every prize lands on the same tx-index instead of consecutive nonces). Deliberately NO nonReentrant here: each item runs through the external self-call `this.liquidate(...)` which takes the lock itself — a guard on the batch would make every item revert Reentrant (proven by prototype test C2). Reentrancy stays closed: every entry point is onlyOwnerOrSelf / onlyOwner / onlyMorpho (prototype C2b). A failed item emits BatchItemFailed and the loop continues (per-item try/catch); gas must be budgeted by the caller with headroom — a starved tail fails SILENTLY inside the same successful tx (prototype C3c), so outcomes must be read from receipt events only.

clearPlan().notice: Disarm. Also implicit on successful execution (one-shot).

isAuthorized(address).notice: v4 (cascade tier): volley EOAs allowed to FIRE liquidations. Profit still sweeps to `owner` (liquidate() transfers to owner unconditionally), so an authorized key can spend its own gas but never redirect proceeds; a malicious swapTarget from a compromised key is stopped by CannotRepay / the checked profit math (balAfter - balBefore reverts on deficit). Keys are add/remove-able only by owner.

liquidate((address,address,address,addre.notice: Liquidate `borrower` on market `mp`, repaying `repaidShares` of debt, swapping the seized collateral to loanToken via `swapTarget`/`swapCallData`. Reverts unless realized profit (swept to owner) >= `minProfit`. onlyOwner so swap calldata is always our own.

onMorphoLiquidate(uint256,bytes).notice: Morpho callback: collateral already received; swap it to loanToken and make sure the contract can cover `repaidAssets` (Morpho pulls it right after this returns).

planInfo().notice: Cheap bot-side arming check (full plan content stays out of view calls too).

setAuthorized(address,bool).notice: v4: add/remove a volley EOA. Owner-only; profit destination is unaffected.

setPlan((address,address,address,address.notice: Arm (or re-arm, overwriting) the plan. Owner-only: the swap route in the plan is therefore always our own — same trust line as liquidate()'s onlyOwnerOrSelf.

sweep(address).notice: Recover stuck tokens (dust collateral from a partial swap, airdrops) to owner.
